Files never leave this device

Rotate PDF pages and save the result

Turn the whole document or individual pages, check the result in the preview, and download a PDF that opens the right way up everywhere.

How to rotate a PDF

  1. Choose the PDF with sideways or upside-down pages.
  2. Rotate all pages at once, or select a page to turn only that one.
  3. Select Download to save the rotated PDF.

How your files are handled

Your files are opened, changed and saved by this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file on your device is never modified. Closing the tab discards everything, so download your result first.

Questions

Are my files uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser with PDF.js and pdf-lib. Your documents are never sent to a server.
Is the rotation permanent?
Yes. The rotation is written into the downloaded PDF, so it opens the same way in every viewer.
Does rotating change the quality?
No. Only the page rotation setting changes; the page content is copied as it was.
Is it free?
Yes. There is no account, no watermark, no daily limit and no paid tier.
